notes.title: The Dwarves - Update
notes.content:
Dear community,

next to a range of minor fixes, the recently released update brings the following new changes to the game:

- New game mode "Challenges" - Three different challenges on six maps to test your skills
- Three new achievements (for the new challenges)
- New difficulty "Very easy" for the campaign
- Slightly better performance in many scenes due to engine update
- Divided display language and subtitle option
- Added Turkish language
- Optimized camera collision
- Additional graphics settings
- Free Key Bindings

Hope you enjoy it!
Cheers
Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: The Dwarves are now available on Steam!
notes.content:
The Dwarves have arrived. The coolest fantasy race of all time finally has their own, great adventure. Heroic dwarf Tungdil – scholar, smith and blessed with a gentle heart – has to gather a group of fellow companions and embark on an epic journey to save Girdlegard (the once peaceful realm of Men, Elves and Dwarves) from all evil. 

Here is the product page: http://store.steampowered.com/app/403970/

Enjoy, see you in Girdlegard and stay tuned!

notes.title: 2016 s Most Promising RPGs
notes.content:
We’re almost half-way through the year, and it’s not been a bad one. The finale of The Witcher 3. Dark Souls III, for those players who consider it an RPG. A couple of late-arrivals, like Dragon’s Dogma. But as the nights again start to draw darker, what’s up next? Here’s some of the big quests still promised for 2016. As ever, don’t be too surprised to see a few more jump from A to B.
